# 2 Baruch Chapter 13 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** And the Lord said to me: "Baruch, I have heard your prayer and your lamentation is known to me.

**2** But I say to you: whoever is able to endure tribulation and yet not abandon me — such a one shall receive a crown.

**3** But you have mourned greatly on account of Zion and you have been troubled for her sake.

**4** And I tell you: do not set your heart on the prosperity of the nations, lest they prevail over you.

**5** For the nations shall be punished in due time, just as they have sinned, and their punishment shall come in their time.

**6** But as for you, set not your heart on the nations, but remember well your works; for after your works shall your reward be determined.

**7** For I will not forget the covenant which I made with your fathers, and I will call to remembrance them who have passed away.

**8** For great are the things which the Most High has prepared for those who do righteousness in due season.

**9** For a lamp that shines within a house shall be extinguished when it is no longer needed; but the light of the righteous shall shine forever.

**10** And now therefore be encouraged and prepare yourself, and continue to believe me and trust in me; for I am the Mighty One and my face shall not be hidden from you.

**11** But the light of the morning shall come upon you after the darkness, and the salvation of God shall come to those who wait.

**12** Prepare yourself therefore for what shall befall you, and remember what was foretold of you; for out of Zion shall the law go forth, and out of Jerusalem the word of the Lord."

---

*LOGOS notes: God's first encouragement to Baruch. V.2 crown of endurance. V.12 quotes Isa 2:3/Mic 4:2. "Most High" = Elyon. "My face shall not be hidden" = continued divine presence despite destruction.*
